title: The soul's form at departure
english: Perhaps the form the soul takes at its departure can be understood in this way: it resembles the coarse and earthly body. Whenever one of those who have died is reported to have appeared, he has been seen resembling the form he had while he still possessed flesh.

Then again, Samuel also, when he appeared, was visible, as is clear, and this shows that he was clothed with a body. This is especially so if the proofs compel us to declare the substance of the soul to be incorporeal, and to declare this.

title: The rich man and Lazarus teach that the soul now uses a body
english: Consider the rich man being punished and the poor man resting in Abraham's bosom. Both are described as being in these states before the coming of the Savior and before the end of the age, and therefore before the resurrection. The one is punished in Hades, and the other rests in Abraham's bosom. They teach us that even now, at its departure, the soul uses a body.

title: The resurrected will be fleshless like angels
english: Origen declared that the Lord pronounced, at the point where the Sadducees test him, that "those who attain the resurrection will then be equal to angels."

Origen then added: "The angels exist without flesh in the height of blessedness, and for this reason they also possess glory. And since we too are going to be made equal to angels, it must necessarily be that we will be without flesh just as they are."
